description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character with a green hime cut: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: the long straight hair that hangs down her back and, seen from the front, its two long sections on both sides of the body, drawn as clear long locks with darker lines between them and a few lighter strands along them, falling straight to the waist, the ends tapered into soft points of slightly different lengths that together make a gentle rounded curve, never one straight horizontal cut. The same bright grass green as the hair above, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. Do not change the bangs, the face, the long pointed ears, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
